acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical barnacle colonization on both lobe tips and significant irregular jaggedness on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Specific grouping of dark, vertically-oriented pigmentation spots in the upper-medial region of the left lobe.
